questionReview.note: Both Q1 alternatives correspond: A sole-trader accounts and B company accounts, each split into trading/profit-and-loss 80 and balance sheet 40. All adjustments on paper 2–5 and original solutions on scheme 3–6 are retained. The A/B instruction is outer question choice; both routes are present.
Farm capital 20 and both enterprise accounts at 20 each correspond on paper 6 and scheme 7–8. The electricity and wage workings on 8 support both enterprise accounts. No internal choice.

All five journal corrections share 35, with corrected profit 25, matching paper 7 and scheme 9. The suspense account is mentioned as source context but not independently requested, so no extra task is invented.
Buildings 15, depreciation 20, disposal 15 and revaluation reserve 10 correspond on paper 8 and scheme 10. Both 2019 and 2020 are required within each relevant ledger.
All four calculations and four meanings at 10 each, combined acid-test calculation/meaning 10 and profitability comment 10 correspond on paper 10–11 and scheme 11. No internal choice.
Operating reconciliation 30, complete cash-flow statement 60 and net-debt reconciliation 10 correspond on paper 12–13 and scheme 12. All six cash-flow headings are required in one statement.
Tourism-business capital 30, income/expenditure 40 and balance sheet 30 correspond on paper 14 and scheme 13–14. All five adjustments, including household supplies and guest deposits, are retained.

Both absorption rates at 15 each, both job-cost calculations at 16 each, selling price 10 and two open costing reasons 8 correspond on paper 15 and scheme 15. The scheme labels the job 330 while the paper says 130; the data and calculations correspond. Both rate methods are required.

Both Comfort and Standard slippers are required in all six budget tasks (14/16/16/16/10/8), matching paper 16 and scheme 16. The paper uses grams but the scheme usage totals are labelled kg; numerical workings correspond. All Irish solution tables are upright. Scheme 17 is the Irish-bonus table, 18–19 blank and 20 cover.
